RESEARCH DIRECTION (single, for the BrainBodyFM 2026 5-pager): 'The Transductive-to-Inductive Generalization Gap in Gait World Models: a Leave-One-Source-Video-Out (LOSO) Re-pretraining Protocol.' Grounding: every classifier lane is transductive; no fold-local encoder retraining was ever run; the source video (35 videos / 96 canonical sequences) is the independent unit; and a provenance confound (63/75 normal rows from the added extraction path) means the 0.72-0.79 accuracies conflate motor semantics with acquisition style. Plan: enumerate the 35 source videos, re-run the 600-epoch curriculum (or Stage 0 + added stages) one time per held-out source video (or grouped source folds), freeze each fold-local EMA encoder, embed the held-out videos, fit the same seeded RF readout, and report the transductive-minus-LOSO gap per condition and pooled. Include three per-fold controls: missingness-only floor, raw-coordinate ceiling, and a provenance-matched canonical-only subset (drop the 63 augmented-normal windows) to isolate extraction-path confounds from true motor semantics. Novelty/venue fit: converts the project's deepest weakness into a reusable, pre-registered null-protocol for small-n single-center biosignal world-model claims, directly matching the workshop's 'evaluation protocols and standardized benchmarks' and 'measuring whether pretraining helps' themes; it is tractable because full-curriculum retraining is ~20 min and frozen checkpoints already exist.
